---
name: hypothesis-research
description: Turn one observed phenomenon into a source-linked mechanism, transfer checklist, parameter flag and predeclared official-simulator experiment.
---

Follow [RESEARCH](../../../docs/agent/RESEARCH.md).
Check payoff/dynamics/information/queue/latency/penalty/markout before formulas.
Use only relevant knowledge references and record actual read depth.
Declare baseline, expected sign, fit/test window and rejection condition.
Keep a non-working mechanic disabled rather than erasing it and its history.
No unlicensed copying, future data or private winning probabilities.
